summary: Compact Noether R121 Paper 15 no-duplicate audit. It verifies that old RA54, RA78, and RA85 Paper 15 repairs are already present in R121, so those patches should not be replayed onto the current cumulative.
verification_summary: R121 contains the P15 article boundary with clear page and footnote reset.
R121 contains the visible numbered Paper 15 title.
R121 already has the RA54 Latin x index correction in the normalization block.
R121 already has the RA54 Schur citation correction S. 355 (1912), not S. 555 (1912).
R121 preserves the RA54 no-fix traps checked here.
limitations: No new TeX patch is included.
No source images, reader PDFs, or translations are included.
Checks survival of already accepted repairs only; it is not a fresh dense-math certification.
Best local P15 source package is recorded as native 360 PPI; later 1000 DPI crops are enlargements, not additional optical detail.
Not P15 closure, not whole-corpus certification, and not a critical edition.
recommended_next_action: Use as a compact skip/anti-duplication guardrail for active Noether web work. Upload only as coordination/provenance evidence if useful; do not present it as reader output or source closure.
